total_net_sales.description: Extract from the financial statements tables only, not from narrative or summary text

quarterly_sales.description: Most recent quarter total net sales in millions, as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations table

quarterly_prior_year_sales.description: Same quarter prior year total net sales in millions, as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations table

quarterly_growth_pct.description: Year-over-year quarterly sales growth as a percentage, calculated from the table values

full_year_sales.description: Full fiscal year total net sales in millions, as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations table

full_year_prior_year_sales.description: Prior fiscal year total net sales in millions, as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations table

full_year_growth_pct.description: Year-over-year full year sales growth as a percentage, calculated from the table values

operating_income.description: Extract from the financial statements tables only, not from narrative or summary text

quarterly_operating_income.description: Most recent quarter operating income in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Operations table

quarterly_operating_margin_pct.description: Most recent quarter operating income divided by net sales as a percentage

full_year_operating_income.description: Full fiscal year operating income in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Operations table

full_year_operating_margin_pct.description: Full fiscal year operating income divided by net sales as a percentage

net_income_and_eps.description: Extract from the financial statements tables only, not from narrative or summary text

quarterly_net_income.description: Most recent quarter net income in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Operations table

quarterly_eps_basic.description: Most recent quarter basic earnings per share in dollars, from the financial statements table

quarterly_eps_diluted.description: Most recent quarter diluted earnings per share in dollars, from the financial statements table

full_year_net_income.description: Full fiscal year net income in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Operations table

full_year_eps_basic.description: Full fiscal year basic earnings per share in dollars, from the financial statements table

full_year_eps_diluted.description: Full fiscal year diluted earnings per share in dollars, from the financial statements table

cash_flow.description: Extract from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table only

operating_cash_flow.description: Net cash provided by operating activities in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table

free_cash_flow.description: Free cash flow in millions, from the cash flow table or supplemental data table

capex.description: Extract from the financial statements tables and footnotes

total_capex.description: Purchases of property and equipment in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table. Use the absolute value of the line item labeled 'Purchases of property and equipment' or 'Payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment'. Do not add finance leases or other items.

major_investments.description: Summary of major capital investment plans or disclosures mentioned in the document

segments.description: Business segment breakdown from the Segment Information table. Each item is one reportable segment. Segments may be defined by business line (e.g. North America, AWS) or by geography (e.g. Americas, Europe) depending on the company.

segment_name.description: Name of the reportable segment exactly as it appears in the Segment Information table

quarterly_net_sales.description: Most recent quarter net sales for this segment in millions, from the segment table

quarterly_prior_year_net_sales.description: Same quarter prior year net sales for this segment in millions, from the segment table

quarterly_yoy_growth_pct.description: Year-over-year quarterly net sales growth for this segment as a percentage

quarterly_operating_income.description: Most recent quarter operating income for this segment in millions, from the segment table

quarterly_operating_margin_pct.description: Most recent quarter segment operating income divided by segment net sales as a percentage

revenue_mix_pct.description: This segment's most recent quarter net sales as a percentage of total consolidated net sales

cash_flow_and_liquidity.description: Detailed cash flow and liquidity data from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows and Balance Sheets tables

capital_expenditures.description: Capital spending detail from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table

purchases_of_property_and_equipment.description: Absolute value of purchases of property and equipment (or payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment) in millions, from the cash flow table

finance_lease_additions.description: Property and equipment acquired under finance leases in millions, from the cash flow table or supplemental section. Return 0 if not present.

proceeds_from_asset_sales.description: Proceeds from property and equipment sales and incentives in millions, from the cash flow table. Return 0 if not present.

debt_repayments.description: Debt repayment activity from the financing activities section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table

long_term_debt_repayments.description: Absolute value of repayments of long-term debt or term debt in millions, from the cash flow table

short_term_debt_repayments.description: Absolute value of repayments of short-term debt or commercial paper in millions, from the cash flow table. Return 0 if not present.

lease_obligations.description: Lease payment obligations from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table

finance_lease_principal_repayments.description: Absolute value of principal repayments of finance leases in millions, from the cash flow table. Return 0 if not present.

operating_lease_payments.description: Cash paid for operating leases in millions, from the supplemental cash flow section. Return 0 if not present.

liquidity.description: Available cash and securities from the Consolidated Balance Sheets table, using the most recent period

cash_and_equivalents.description: Cash and cash equivalents in millions, from the most recent balance sheet date

current_marketable_securities.description: Current marketable securities in millions, from the most recent balance sheet. Return 0 if not listed separately.

non_current_marketable_securities.description: Non-current or long-term marketable securities in millions, from the most recent balance sheet. Return 0 if not listed separately.

total_debt.description: Total debt (sum of short-term and long-term debt, term debt, and commercial paper) in millions, from the most recent balance sheet
